items.name: sage
items.title: Sage
items.description: Agent thinking states as a status chip: a pixel-art wizard at his desk who does whatever the agent is doing. One file, no dependencies, defines <sage-status>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Sage is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /pixel-worlds/sage.js with a script tag, then use <sage-status state="thinking"></sage-status> and call el.set(state, label, detail). States: thinking, searching, reading, running, writing, waiting, done, failed. More: https://pixel-worlds.vercel.app

items.name: hoard
items.title: Hoard
items.description: A hold-to-delete button with a pixel-art dragon in it. Hold and the fire is the fill; hold to the end and it fires hoard:delete. One file, no dependencies, defines <hoard-button>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Hoard is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /pixel-worlds/hoard.js with a script tag, then use <hoard-button heading="Delete this project" warning="This can't be undone."></hoard-button> and listen for the hoard:delete event. More: https://pixel-worlds.vercel.app

items.name: raven
items.title: Raven
items.description: A send button with a pixel-art raven in it. He carries the message across the button to a tower window, and that flight is the progress. One file, no dependencies, defines <raven-send>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Raven is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /pixel-worlds/raven.js with a script tag, then use <raven-send></raven-send>. Set the progress attribute (0 to 1) from your own send, or leave it off for a timed flight on click. Listen for the raven:sent event. More: https://pixel-worlds.vercel.app

items.name: round
items.title: Round
items.description: A loading bar that is the bar of a tavern: seven pixel-art regulars empty their cups in turn as the task loads. One file, no dependencies, defines <round-bar>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Round is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /pixel-worlds/round.js with a script tag, then use <round-bar value="0" label="Loading"></round-bar> and call el.set(n) with progress from 0 to 1. Listen for the round:done event. More: https://pixel-worlds.vercel.app

items.name: keep
items.title: Keep
items.description: A password field where strength is a castle: each keystroke builds more of it, and a raccoon tests what you built. One file, no dependencies, defines <keep-field>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Keep is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /pixel-worlds/keep.js with a script tag, then use <keep-field></keep-field>. Read el.value and el.score (0 to 1), and listen for the keep:change event. More: https://pixel-worlds.vercel.app

items.name: sigil
items.title: Sigil
items.description: A loading spinner that is a summoning circle cut into dark stone and lit only by a wisp. With no value the wisp circles the ring; give it a value and the runes charge one by one; at 100% something answers. One file, no dependencies, defines <sigil-spinner>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Sigil is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /pixel-worlds/sigil.js with a script tag, then use <sigil-spinner label="Loading"></sigil-spinner>. With no value it is a plain spinner. Call el.set(n) with progress from 0 to 1 to light the runes, el.set(1) to finish, and listen for the sigil:done event. More: https://pixel-worlds.vercel.app
